summary: WISeKey International Holding AG filed a 6-K reporting the planned effectiveness of its redomiciliation from Switzerland to the British Virgin Islands via a cross-border merger into wholly owned subsidiary WISeQey Corp., expected effective October 2, 2026, after shareholder approval at the September 9, 2026 EGM. WISeQey succeeds to all assets, rights, liabilities and obligations; its ordinary shares are expected to trade on Nasdaq Global Market and SIX Swiss Exchange under ticker WQEY from about October 5, 2026. Holders receive WISeQey securities per previously communicated exchange ratios. Watch exchange-ratio mechanics, tax treatment and trading liquidity during ticker transition.
